sections.title: What it is
sections.body: The number that sets how many damage dice a PC rolls with weapons and many damaging features.

sections.title: How it works
sections.body: Use after a successful PC attack or when a feature references Proficiency.

sections.title: Step by step
items: Use after a successful PC attack or when a feature references Proficiency.
Roll a number of damage dice equal to Proficiency, then add the listed modifier.
Return to the fiction with the concrete result, cost, or benefit.
